🇮🇹4-Day Amalfi Coast Itinerary: A Perfect Italian Getaway ⬇️

📍SAVE this post for when you are visiting the Amalfi Coast.

Day 1 – Positano & Beach Relaxation
Arrive in Positano and check into a cliffside hotel with breathtaking sea views. Wander through pastel-colored streets, browse charming boutiques, and enjoy a seafood lunch at a beachfront restaurant. Spend the afternoon sunbathing at Spiaggia Grande or Fornillo Beach. In the evening, dine at a romantic terrace restaurant with views of the twinkling coastline.

Day 2 – Amalfi & Ravello Exploration
Take a scenic ferry or drive to Amalfi, the heart of the coast. Visit the stunning Amalfi Cathedral and stroll around Piazza del Duomo. Have a limoncello tasting and savor fresh local cuisine. In the afternoon, head up to Ravello, known for its breathtaking views and historic villas. Explore Villa Rufolo and Villa Cimbrone's famous Terrazza dell'Infinito. Enjoy a sunset dinner overlooking the coastline.

Day 3 – Capri Day Trip
Catch a morning ferry to the glamorous island of Capri. Take a boat tour around the island, visiting the famous Blue Grotto. Ride the funicular up to Capri Town for high-end shopping and a delicious lunch in the lively Piazzetta. Hike to the Gardens of Augustus for panoramic views, or take a scenic chairlift ride to Monte Solaro. Return to the Amalfi Coast for a relaxing evening.

Day 4 – Sorrento & Departure
Drive or take a ferry to Sorrento, a charming town known for its lemon groves and beautiful views of the Bay of Naples. Wander through the historic center, visit the Cloister of San Francesco, and enjoy a final Italian meal before heading to the airport or your next destination.

I love boutique hotels, I'm very bullish on them and I think they're the future of the hotel space. However, the often hold themselves back by focusing too much on what the competition is doing.

"How can we be like the Four Seasons, but cheaper with less amenities?"

If your foundational starting point is another brand, you've already lost because what makes boutique hotels so great is their size, flexibility and unique visions.
